WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Fund Accountant – Private Equity Real Estate EisnerAmper LLP September 2025 – Present
• • • •
Perform cash and bank reconciliations across funds and deals. Support annual audit with schedules and documentation. Preparation of audit request from investors. Preparation of borrowing request, interest reconciliation, wire instructions and maintaining invoice tracker Tools used: Yardi, MRI and MS Excel.
Fund Accountant – Associate 3 Apex Fund Services 10/2023 – 09/2025, Kolkata
Managed end-to-end NAV calculation and financial reporting for Private Equity funds. • • • • •
Performed cash and position reconciliations, identifying discrepancies and resolving financial data inconsistencies. Processed capital calls, distributions, and partner capital account statements (PCAPs). Supported financial statement preparation under IFRS, Lux GAAP, and Dutch GAAP. Prepared NAV packs, investor reports, and audit schedules for global clients. Trained team members on NAV validation and Efront platform usage to improve reporting accuracy.
Fund Administrator HSBC 07/2021 – 09/2023, Kolkata



Processed key fund documents including Capital Calls, Waterfall Distributions, and Partner Capital Account Statements (PCAPs). Contributed to NAV valuation and accounting for Alternative Investments, primarily Private Equity funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards. Supported monthly and quarterly fund valuation processes, applying knowledge of capital markets, financial instruments, and accounting principles.
Managed end-to-end NAV calculation process for Private Equity funds. •
Performed NAV calculations for institutional clients, supporting accurate financial reporting and investment decision-making.
